knowledge_graph.title: Betty White
knowledge_graph.description: Betty Marion Ludden, known professionally as Betty White, was an American actress and comedian. A pioneer of early television with a career spanning almost seven decades, she was noted for her vast number of television appearances, acting in sitcoms, sketch comedy, and game shows.
knowledge_graph.died: December 31, 2021 (age 99 years), Brentwood, Los Angeles, CA
knowledge_graph.spouse: Allen Ludden (m. 1963–1981), Lane Allen (m. 1947–1949), Dick Barker (m. 1945–1945)
knowledge_graph.parents: Tess Curtis White, Horace Logan White

related_questions.question: Why was Betty White's house demolished?

text_blocks.snippet: Betty White's Brentwood home was demolished because it was sold as a "tear-down" property. The new owners intended to demolish the existing structure to build a new home on the lot. It was purchased for its land value, with the understanding that the house itself would be removed.
